ui.text: Tap the object on your screen!
Point your camera at a picture of an artifact!
Select a character to begin your journey through Ancient Rome
Point your camera at any artifact in the museum to identify it and learn more. The AR scanner will automatically detect and recognize artifacts from the collection.
Use the Kelsey Dex to explore all artifacts in the collection. Filter by region, era, or material type to find artifacts that interest you. Tap the bookmark icon to save favorites for later.
View interactive 3D models of artifacts. Use rotation controls to examine artifacts from all angles, and zoom in to see fine details and craftsmanship up close.
Test your knowledge with interactive quizzes about each artifact. Learn about the artifact's history, cultural significance, and the civilization that created it.

Enable audio descriptions for detailed spoken information about artifacts. Enlarge text for better readability, or toggle high contrast mode for improved visibility. Audio playback highlights text as it reads.
• Use headphones for the best audio description experience
• Ensure good lighting when scanning artifacts
• Explore related artifacts to discover connections
• Save your favorites to create your own personal collection

Black-figure pottery was a revolutionary technique where figures were painted in black slip and details were incised before firing. This technique flourished in Athens from the 7th to 5th centuries BCE.
The Classical Period (450-323 BCE) represents the height of Greek artistic achievement, coinciding with the Age of Pericles and the construction of the Parthenon.
